hook: Her flight is cancelled. Her boss has one question.
excerpt: He got into the car. He looked at my face.
“Sion is closing at ten,” I said. “I’m working on it.”
He was silent for a moment. Then he said, “How long is your notice?”
A question about me that didn’t end in a booking reference, and he chose now to ask it.
“Until the fifth of January,” I said.

excerpt.text: “Then get me home,” said Elliot Hale, and turned to the window again, and Luc pulled out into the snow.

caption:
The airport is closing. Her notice runs out in two weeks. And he picks now to ask about her. ❄️

From chapter one of Rerouted for Christmas, Out of Office · Book One.
